sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 740. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Removes all debuffs when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Recovers 20% of max HP when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Recovers 5 Cost when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 90 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Removes special status ailments.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +200
Only [Ringmaster of Splendor] Lucifer can be used as Unlocking Potential material
